content.title: Credit Fuels the AI Boom — and Fears of a Bubble
content.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group are leading the sale of a more than $22 billion loan to support Vantage Data Centers’ plan to build a massive data-center campus, people with knowledge of the matter said this week. content.title: How Urban Outfitters’ Nuuly Stole the Show From Rent the Runway
content.summary: Rent the Runway  might have introduced young consumers to the idea of renting their wardrobes.  Nuuly, a unit of  Urban Outfitters  seems to be the one that is actually making it work.  “Rental only works if you already have scale,” said  Simeon Siegel,  former retail analyst at BMO Capital Markets.

content.title: Rent the Runway CEO on customer loyalty, tariffs, & competition

content.title: Rent The Runway Q1 Subscriber Growth Returns, Eyes Double-Digit Increase In FY25
content.summary: Rent The Runway, Inc. (NASDAQ:RENT) shares are trading higher premarket on Friday after the company reported first-quarter financial results on Thursday after market close. The rent and subscription based e-commerce platform clocked GAAP earnings per share of $6.58 loss, beating the street view of $8.35 loss.
